## Session Overview

Welcome to UP 591: Capstone Seminar! This is the start of your final two semesters in the MUP program - by May you'll have completed a capstone, a portfolio, a job plan, and will have built a network of professional relationships. This year's seminar is designed to give structure to those professional development activities and program milestones.

### Learn

We'll spend time reviewing the goals and expectations of the course as well as our course structure, including the mentoring component.

### Review

We will spend time in small groups workshopping and sharing the identifying statements you wrote in your updated draft Plan of Study.

## Before we Meet

- Watch our **August pre-session video** that provides an overview of the capstone year and professional development goals.

- Update your Plan of Study ([Plan of Study template](../milestones/files/MUP Plan of Study Template 20240819.docx)) and bring an electronic version of your updated Plan of Study to class.

- Bring a short professional bio and your résumé.

- Draft a one-paragraph professional identity statement — *what kind of planner are you becoming?*

- Bring a computer to class for our Plan of Study Peer Review session so you can add comments and feedback during our peer review session.

## After we Meet

- Submit your intake materials (bio, résumé, professional identity statement, updated Plan of Study).

- Complete the mentor matching survey so we can pair you with a mentor in September.

- Revise and submit your updated Plan of Study.

**Mentoring milestone:** Intake — August materials collected for matching.
